title: Reference link `[`Text`]` is not linked
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`. A reference-style link whose label is inline code is not turned into a link. Input: ``` [`Text`] [`Text`]: http://example.com ``` Expected: `

Text

` Actual: `

[Text]

` Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
